content.text:
**Finding: missing** — inserted a new Section 10.3 (transition assistance / data return / certified deletion).

The Agreement has no exit clause. Section 10.1 refers to "any agreed transition period" without granting one; Section 10.2 covers only Deliverables and refunds; and Section 16.5's return-or-destroy duty expressly excludes Customer Data, deferring it to "Sections 11 and 15" — Section 11 does not exist in this document, and Section 15 addresses only processing limits and privacy compliance. Neither the preferred nor the 90-day fallback position is met, so I proposed the preferred language (6 months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return within 30 days, certified deletion thereafter, with the same backup/legal-retention carve-out already used in Section 16.5), noting the 90-day fallback in the comment.
